name: München
author: pierreggt
description: Map of München, Germany, from the city center to Munich Airport, spanning the full S-Bahn network into the surrounding Oberbayern region (Dachau, Starnberg, Freising, Erding, and other satellite towns). Demand is anchored to real German labor-market statistics: official employment-at-workplace counts (Beschäftigtenstatistik) and municipality-to-municipality commuter flows (Pendlerrechnung der Länder) cover München plus its 10 largest satellite municipalities — roughly 76% of the map's total modeled jobs — with a gravity model filling in the remaining smaller towns. Residential population comes from the official 2022 census 100m population grid (Zensus 2022).
data_source: Zensus 2022 (Destatis), Beschäftigtenstatistik BA + Pendlerrechnung der Länder (regionalstatistik.de/GENESIS-Online), OSM, Overture Maps
